\begin{example} \end{example}[lens spaces collapse to $S^2(1/2)$]

Source: petersen:page-0412 ↗ ex:pet-ch11-finite-approximation-3eps 1. ch11:11.1.6Equip $M_k=S^3/\mathbb {Z}_k$ with the metric induced by $S^3(1)$. The Riemannian submersion $M_k\to S^2(1/2)$ has fibres of diameter $2\pi /k\to 0$; using subsection 1.1 it follows that $M_k\to S^2(1/2)$ in the Gromov--Hausdorff topology. \end{example}
